title: Permitted multiplexes (2 to 6 units), Toronto
source: City of Toronto Open Data: Building Permits - Active Permits and Cleared Permits
rule: permits creating 2 to 6 units since 2022-01-01, non-SFD structure, one row per project; cancelled, refused and withdrawn removed
caveats: A permit is not a finished building: it shows what the City permitted, not what stands today.
Unit counts are gross: units lost to demolition are not subtracted.
Some permits cannot be geocoded and are left out.

Locations are the street only: each permit is drawn at the middle of its block (several on one block in a small ring round it), never at its house, so counts near an address can be off by a block at the edge of the circle. Work type is derived from the permit's work and description fields.
